subject.title: fix(providers): honor proxies in model discovery

question: Should canonical provider catalog endpoints, including the OpenAI and OpenAI Codex catalog endpoints, be allowed to inherit eligible HTTP(S) proxy environment settings while all operator-overridden, local, and cleartext discovery endpoints remain strict-direct?
rationale: This is an intentional network-routing and credential-exposure boundary change, not a mechanical correctness question; the correct permanent trust scope requires maintainer ownership and the repository’s Codex-contract gate.

options.title: Approve the scoped trusted-proxy policy
options.body: Accept proxy use only for the canonical HTTPS vendor endpoints already guarded by the branch, after checking the final rebased head and the Codex catalog contract.

options.title: Narrow the trusted endpoint set
options.body: Retain the fixes for confirmed vendor catalogs but remove any endpoint whose ownership or credential-routing contract is not explicitly approved.

options.title: Keep all discovery direct
options.body: Reject the routing policy change and retain static-catalog fallback behavior on proxy-required networks.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped trusted-proxy policy
recommendation.body: Accept proxy use only for the canonical HTTPS vendor endpoints already guarded by the branch, after checking the final rebased head and the Codex catalog contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigns this PR to steipete, who also authored the consolidation and the final local/custom-endpoint scope guards.
